question.problem: In an inverse variation, $y=5$ when $x=8.$ Find an equation that relates $x$ and $y.$
question.worked_solution:
Since $y$ varies inversely with $x,$ we use the equation

$$
y=\dfrac{k}{x}.
$$

Next, we use the data $y=5$ when $x=8$ to find $k\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}5 & =\frac{k}{8} \\ 5\cdot 8 & =k \\ 40 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our inverse variation equation is

$$
y = \dfrac{40}{x}.
$$
